integrity: Standalone exact-rational and numerical checker supplements, but does not replace, the all-parameter analytic proof; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-conductance complete bipartite graphs with both sides of size at least two; real finite-metric negative type. No weighted, multipartite, shortest-path or infinite-graph extension; possible unindexed equivalent literature.
title: A sharp Euclidean balance boundary for complete-bipartite resistance metrics
